items.explanation_en: Coordinate the king, bishop, and knight to drive the enemy king into a corner. The bishop covers one color complex while the knight controls neighboring squares.

items.label_en: 2. Choose the Corner by Bishop Color
items.explanation_en: The dark-squared bishop targets h8. Use the king and knight to drive the enemy king into a matching-color corner and deliver mate.

items.label_en: 1. Draw: King Holds the A8 Corner
items.explanation_en: The black king reaches the a8 corner, where the knight cannot drive it away and the promoted queen can be captured.

items.label_en: 2. Use King and Knight to Promote
items.explanation_en: Activate the king, use pawn checks to displace the defender, and bring the knight to key squares to support promotion.
Use the king and knight to drive the defender away, occupy key squares to block its routes, and promote the pawn safely.

items.label_en: 4. Capture the Extra Pawn, Then Promote
items.explanation_en: Activate the knight to capture Black's pawn, then coordinate king, knight, and pawn to promote.
Force the black knight to capture the white knight, clearing the d-pawn's route to promotion.

items.label_en: 2. Escort the B-Pawn with the Knight
items.explanation_en: Keep the knight in front of the b-pawn and use the king to support its advance to promotion.

items.label_en: 3. Use Checks to Clear the Promotion Route
items.explanation_en: Advance the pawn with king and knight support, using knight checks to displace the defender from the promotion square.

items.label_en: 4. Capture the Checking Knight and Promote
items.explanation_en: The e-pawn can capture the checking knight and promote with check, turning Black's defense into a losing exchange.
Use Ne6, Ng5+, and Ne4 to attack the blockading knight and force it to capture the white knight, clearing the promotion route.

items.label_en: 6. Draw by Holding the Promotion Square
items.explanation_en: Black draws with knight checks and by keeping the king on e8 and the knight on e7 to block promotion.

items.label_en: 1. Draw by Guarding the Promotion Square
items.explanation_en: The knight checks and shuttles between a6 and b8 to keep the b8 promotion square defended.

items.label_en: 2. The Distant Knight Cannot Stop Promotion
items.explanation_en: Restrict the distant knight with the king, promote the a-pawn, and capture the knight with the new queen.

items.label_en: 3. Draw with Checks and Square Control
items.explanation_en: Use knight checks to displace the king while keeping the a8 promotion square under control.
The knight is too far away to stop promotion; use the new queen and king to capture it.
The knight draws by using checks to gain the exact tempi needed to catch the b-pawn before promotion.
